title: Leray spectral sequence for a continuous map of spaces
statement: Let f:Z\to X be a continuous map of topological spaces [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], and let F be an abelian sheaf on Z. Let f_* be the direct-image functor on abelian sheaves given by (f_*F)(U)=F(f^{-1}U), a left exact additive functor [def-sp-left-exact-additive] from abelian sheaves on Z to abelian sheaves on X, and let R^qf_* be its right derived functors [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Then there are functorial first-quadrant cohomological spectral-sequence pages (E_r^{a,b},d_r)_{r>=2}, with d_r:E_r^{a,b}\to E_r^{a+r,b-r+1}, d_r\circ d_r=0, and E_{r+1}^{a,b}\cong ker(d_r:E_r^{a,b}\to E_r^{a+r,b-r+1})/im(d_r:E_r^{a-r,b+r-1}\to E_r^{a,b}). They satisfy E_2^{a,b}=H^a(X,R^bf_*F) for a,b>=0 and E_2^{a,b}=0 otherwise. For each n>=0, they converge to H^n(Z,F) in the sense that there is a finite decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration] H^n(Z,F)=F^0H^n\supseteq F^1H^n\supseteq\cdots\supseteq F^{n+1}H^n=0 with F^aH^n/F^{a+1}H^n\cong E_\infty^{a,n-a}, where E_\infty^{a,b}=E_r^{a,b} for all sufficiently large r. The pages, differentials, filtrations, and these identifications are functorial in F. Its edge map E_2^{p,0}=H^p(X,f_*F)\to E_\infty^{p,0}=F^pH^p(Z,F)\subseteq H^p(Z,F) is the Leray edge map; it is the map induced by f.
